validity.researcher_notes: Followed the wiki's own citation list (the required starting point) rather than open-web search first. Of its 2 citations, one (a generic PNGRB 'Natural Gas Pipelines Network in India — As on 31 March 2022' data-bank listing) is a JS-rendered accordion page I could not pull a usable PDF link out of this session. The other — https://pngrb.gov.in/pdf/public-notice/GSPL02022021.pdf, link text 'Approval for laying spur pipeline from Jamnagar to Dwarka' — resolved live (200, application/pdf, 1.9MB, pngrb.gov.in, last-modified 2025 re-serve) and I read the full document directly (it is a scanned/image PDF with no text layer, so url_verifier's substring screen FAILs on every token including 'Jamnagar' and 'Dwarka' — a known false-negative class per the verifier's own docstring, here caused by the doc being a photographed/scanned letter rather than a large-PDF extraction miss; I am citing it on the strength of having read it directly, not the automated screen). It is a formal letter dated 18-Jan-2021 from GSPL's Group ED (Gas Business) to the PNGRB Secretary, subject 'Approval for laying spur pipeline from Jamnagar (Gujarat) to Dwarka (Gujarat)', requesting authorisation under PNGRB (Authorizing Entities to Lay, Build, Operate or Expand Natural Gas Pipelines) Amended Regulations 2014, Reg 21(3) (the spur-line exemption: branches off a trunk line, diameter ≤ trunk, no compressor, uses trunk capacity — all four conditions are explicitly checked off in the letter). This independently confirms EXISTENCE (a real regulatory filing by the named owner, not a GEM-only entity) and CLASSIFICATION (GSPL frames it throughout as a spur of its own High-Pressure Gujarat Gas Grid TRANSMISSION network — branching from the 30-inch trunk main at Jamnagar and feeding Gujarat Gas Limited's city-gas-distribution network plus industrial clusters at Khambhalia/Dwarka/Okha — i.e. still HP transmission-grade pipe, not a distribution-network asset itself; PipelineType=transmission on the sheet is correct). No DUPLICATE risk: no other pipeline in the 27-row India-gas roster touches Jamnagar or Dwarka. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1=Gujarat State Petronet is confirmed — the letter is GSPL's own filing, on GSPL letterhead, signed by GSPL's Group Executive Director (Gas Business). SPEC: the filing's own numbers match the sheet exactly — Annexure-I 'Project Details' states 'GSPL proposes to lay 100 kms x 18" pipeline from Jamnagar to Dwarka' and the summary table gives 'Spur-line length: about 100 kms' and 'Capacity of the Pipeline: ... about 3 MMSCMD', matching GEM's LengthKnown=100 km and Capacity=3.00 MMSCMD precisely, and supplying a genuinely new data point (18-inch diameter) the sheet currently leaves blank. Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are already ref-supported on the sheet (existing_ref_checks ok:true) and this filing corroborates both independently. One thing this source can NOT do: confirm the sheet's current Status='construction' or StartYear1=2024 — as of this letter (Jan 2021) the project was a PROPOSAL awaiting Board approval, with a stated 36-month build schedule starting only 'from the date of receipt of all Statutory approvals' (i.e. not yet running as of the letter). See the status_reviews entry for that open question. Also checked: the PNGRB NGPL MIS register (this batch's register_crosswalk.json) explicitly classifies P3909 as ABSENT_DEDICATED_OR_TIE_IN — i.e. by design the regulator's common-carrier register does not carry standalone spur/tie-in lines like this one, which is fully consistent with the letter's own Reg 21(3) argument that the spur does not require separate common-carrier authorisation. That means the country guidance's 'register is the first stop' does not apply to this particular row — the register's silence is not evidence either way on build status.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Genuinely could not independently confirm or refute 'construction' / StartYear1=2024 this session, despite real effort, so calling it 'unclear' rather than guessing. What I tried: (1) the sheet's own two current Status refs (both data-bank.html anchors) are JS accordion shells — 200 but no extractable 'construction' text, matching the worklist's pre-existing existing_ref_checks flags; (2) the wiki page's body text (read for leads only, never cited) asserts 'the proposal to build the pipeline was approved by PNGRB in August 2021,' but neither of the 2 citations harvested from that page actually supports that specific claim — it is an unsourced editorial assertion I will not rely on; (3) the register_crosswalk.json classifies this row ABSENT_DEDICATED_OR_TIE_IN, meaning PNGRB's NGPL MIS register (the country's normal 'first stop' for status) does not carry standalone spur lines like this one by design (per the GSPL letter's own Reg 21(3) exemption argument) — so its silence is uninformative, not evidence of non-existence or dormancy; (4) checked GSPL's current corporate site for a fresher total-network-length figure that might show whether the 100 km spur has been added since the 2021 letter's baseline of 2,696 km commissioned — the live page states 'approximately 2,703 km' but the same page's throughput figure is explicitly dated 'FY 2022-23', so the length figure is likely also FY22-23-vintage (pre-dating the sheet's claimed 2024 start) and is not usable either way; (5) attempted open web search for independent news of PNGRB approval, construction start, or commissioning — blocked: this session's web-search budget was already exhausted (200/200) before I could run a query, and DuckDuckGo/Bing fetches via WebFetch returned CAPTCHA/irrelevant-cache pages instead of usable results. Net: the only hard date I have is the Jan-2021 GSPL proposal letter itself, which is BEFORE approval/construction, not evidence of the 2024 construction start currently recorded. Since the record's status is 'construction' (not 'proposed' or 'shelved'), the country guidance's explicit 2y/4y dormancy-to-shelved/cancelled rule does not cleanly apply here either. Recommend a follow-up pass with web-search available, specifically for (a) any post-Aug-2021 PNGRB approval order for this spur, and (b) GSPL FY24-25/FY25-26 annual report or investor deck network-length figures, before touching Status.

summary: P3909 Jamnagar-Dwarka spur is real and correctly classified/owned/spec'd (GSPL's own Jan-2021 PNGRB filing matches sheet length/capacity exactly and adds a new 18-in diameter fill + refs for Length/Capacity/Location/Owner); the recorded 'construction'/StartYear1=2024 status could not be independently confirmed this session (verdict=unclear — web search budget exhausted, PNGRB's register excludes spur lines by design, and the sheet's own current Status refs are JS shells with no readable content).
